from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """Financial profit record extracted from a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as stated in the report")
    profit_value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the Total Profit")
    profit_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the profit (e.g., '元', '百万元', '亿元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
